answer_1.quote: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) requires the system to provide help for emotional users through multi-turn conversation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated supportive responses/utterances in multi-turn dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We pay attention to: Alignment with golden response, including BLEU Scores, METEOR Score, Rouge Score (RG) and BERT Score ... Alignment with user's past post, including Coherence ... Predicted Human Feedback, including Humanlike, Non-Random, Depth, and Upvote.

answer_4.quote: We hired three human annotators to interact with the models in multi-turn conversation (for 100 rounds) and choose the better one in light of four criteria: Coherent, Helpful, Informative, and Overall.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two model responses and select the better one based on Coherent, Helpful, Informative, and Overall criteria.
